data.content_ref: inline:Add a parameterized trust threshold over attack edges: each edge carries a warrant strength (direct evidence, inferential, conjectural); for any threshold t, compute the grounded extension on the subgraph of edges with strength >= t. Prove the family is monotone in t, each extension is deterministic and polynomial, and committed roots remain valid because only edges are filtered, never added. This gives a principled way to expand skepticism by choosing t without changing the fixpoint operator.
